{{Top|leg}}
'''Mobile Medical Unit 4-077''' was a mobile hospital of the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]].<ref name="SWG:MHHSP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Mobile Hospital Has Smuggler Problem}} on Corellia</ref>

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the unit was stationed in the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] wilderness for a big training exercise. During this exercise, criminal lowlifes repeatedly tried to steal their medical supplies. When a crate of [[ion beamer]]s was stolen by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], the unit scraped money out of their orotay-filter replenishment fund and hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to find the smugglers, retrieve the crate and destroy their base.<ref name="SWG:MHHSP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mobile Medical Unit 4-077 was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MHHSP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mobile Medical Unit 4-077 was mentioned in a mission called "Mobile Hospital Has Smuggler Problem" available on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:MHHSP" />

The Mobile Medical Unit 4-077 is has a parallel with the 4077th Mobile Army Surgical Hospital, the setting of the novel, movie, and television series [[Wiki:M*A*S*H|''M*A*S*H'']].
